shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .claude/skills/gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo ---; git ls-files | head -50; echo ---; ls src 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; cat vite.config.* 2>/dev/null; cat index.html 2>/dev/null
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css; echo ---; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && sed -n 1,80p build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ======README; grep -n -i -A 40 "required setup\|## Usage\|## Install" README.md | head -120; echo ======COMPONENTS; ls build/docs/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ======PROVIDER; grep -rn -C 3 "Provider" build/docs/guides/*.md | grep -i -m 30 "ThemeProvider\|<Provider\|import {Provider"

ls build/docs/components/controls; echo ======TEXTINPUT; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(value|onUpdate|onChange|type|placeholder|size|label|errorMessage|validationState|autoComplete|id|name|hasClear|startContent|endContent)\`?" build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -30; echo ======PASSWORD; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(value|onUpdate|type|size|label|errorMessage|validationState|autoComplete|hideCopyButton|showRevealButton|showCopyButton)\`?|^import|<PasswordInput" build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -30; echo ======CHECKBOX; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(checked|onUpdate|onChange|content|size|children|defaultChecked)\`?|<Checkbox" build/docs/components/Checkbox.md | head -20; echo ======BUTTON; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(view|size|width|type|loading|onClick)\`?" build/docs/components/Button.md | head -20; echo ======CARD; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(view|type|size|theme|className|style)\`?|<Card" build/docs/components/Card.md | head -20; echo ======TEXT; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(variant|as|color|className|style)\`?" build/docs/components/Text.md | head; echo ======FLEX; grep -n -E "^\| \`?(direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|as|width|style)\`?" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -20

echo ======PASSWORD; sed -n 1,60p build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md; echo ======BUTTON-TYPE; grep -n -E "^\| (type|href|onClick|disabled|qa) " build/docs/components/Button.md; grep -n "ButtonView" build/docs/components/Button.md | head -3; echo ======CARD; grep -n -B2 -A8 -i "^#* *view\b\|view=\"" build/docs/components/Card.md | head -50; echo ======TEXT-COLOR; grep -n -A 20 -i "^#* *color" build/docs/components/Text.md | head -40; echo ======FLEX; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "^#* *Flex" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -90

sed -n 336,420p build/docs/guides/layout.md; echo ======BOX; grep -n -A 30 "^## Box" build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -60; echo ======DTS; grep -n -E "gap|Space|SpacingSize" build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n -E "type\?|'submit'|extends" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n -E "view|theme|type\?" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

grep -n -E "SpacingValue|CardView|CardTheme|CardType" build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -8; echo ======BOX-SPACING; grep -n -E "spacing|padding|style" build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head; echo ======BTN; grep -n -E "ButtonButtonProps|type" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo ======SP; grep -n -E "^export" build/esm/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "spacing-" build/docs/guides/migration-layout-v8.md | head -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && git status --short
cat .gitignore; echo ---; git check-ignore dist || (echo "dist not ignored, removing build output" && rm -rf dist); grep -n gravity package.json
